question: Based on the World Bank global population dataset and the World Bank health nutrition population dataset, how many countries experienced an increase of more than 1% from the previous year to 2018 in both their total population and per capita current health expenditure (PPP)?
sql:
WITH health_2017 AS (
  SELECT country_code, value as health_val_2017
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.health_nutrition_population`
  WHERE indicator_code = 'SH.XPD.CHEX.PP.CD' AND year = 2017
),
health_2018 AS (
  SELECT country_code, value as health_val_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.health_nutrition_population`
  WHERE indicator_code = 'SH.XPD.CHEX.PP.CD' AND year = 2018
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as country_count
FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_global_population.population_by_country` p
JOIN health_2017 h1 ON p.country_code = h1.country_code
JOIN health_2018 h2 ON p.country_code = h2.country_code
WHERE p.year_2017 IS NOT NULL 
  AND p.year_2018 IS NOT NULL
  AND p.year_2017 > 0
  AND h1.health_val_2017 > 0
  AND h2.health_val_2018 > 0
  AND SAFE_DIVIDE(p.year_2018 - p.year_2017, p.year_2017) * 100 > 1
  AND SAFE_DIVIDE(h2.health_val_2018 - h1.health_val_2017, h1.health_val_2017) * 100 > 1
  AND p.country_code NOT IN ('WLD', 'LMC', 'EAR', 'SST', 'NAC', 'TEA', 'MEA', 'EAP', 'SSA', 'LAC', 'HIC', 'LIC')
